clips.title: The story
paras: Outside Ironforge in Dun Morogh, Lieutenant Nevell watches for the Scourge. The Argent Dawn officer coordinates local defenders and warns arriving adventurers of undead threats near the dwarven kingdom.

Lieutenant Nevell watches Ironforge's snowy approaches for the Scourge. Though the Argent Dawn is best known for holding the line in Lordaeron's shattered Plaguelands, its watch reaches farther south. From outside Ironforge, Nevell directs recruits and capable adventurers toward the front when Scourge activity stirs in Dun Morogh's mountain passes. The dwarven city's borders remain under watch.
